decision.reference: Authorization bead bu-o5bhf2 for implementation bead bu-vaha16 (the Health morning briefing adds a medium-priority medication adherence highlight whenever a due dose was not taken, and a next-appointment highlight). Reviewed before: main 7cbcbfa13faa1fbe593d6a0fbb57555adeeed888 as recorded in bu-vaha16 (contract-review-lane local verdict CLEAN-pending-CE after the C1 fix, recomputed pre-manifest; the formal review bead opens with the DRAFT PR while GitHub access is suspended); approved subject: agent/bu-vaha16 head b4c39db35812b87e5f9dded86fc9faacb68065c8 plus the reviewer-computed request. Governing requirement REQ-cross-butler-briefing-contribution-004 (Health Butler Contribution) in openspec/specs/cross-butler-briefing-contribution/spec.md, whose ID-only header lands in this same change ahead of the manifest. The 2 owners (tests/jobs/test_briefing_medication_due.py and tests/jobs/test_briefing_owner_timezone.py) each gain exactly one expected highlight entry, the adherence line the requirement now adds; their fixtures and other assertions are unchanged. This exact manifest requires its own independent review and protected-main publication before consumption; provenance text grants no runtime admission.

owners.reason: The case pins the exact highlight set of a missed-dose day. REQ-cross-butler-briefing-contribution-004 now adds a medium-priority medication adherence highlight whenever some due dose was not taken, so the expected set gains exactly one entry: 'Medication adherence today: 50% (1 of 2 due doses taken)' (Morning pill missed, Taken pill taken; the 20:00, weekly and as-needed medications are not due). The fixture, the missed and due-later entries, the missed_doses count and the summary assertion are unchanged.

The case pins the exact highlight set of a missed-dose day read in the owner's timezone. REQ-cross-butler-briefing-contribution-004 now adds a medium-priority medication adherence highlight whenever some due dose was not taken, so the expected set gains exactly one entry: 'Medication adherence today: 0% (0 of 1 due doses taken)' (at 06:55 PDT only the 06:00 dose is due, and it is untaken; the 20:00 dose is still ahead). The fixture, the owner-local missed and due-later entries and the missed_doses count are unchanged.
